integrity: The analytical proof is supplied; finite numerical diagnostics are independent consistency checks, not exhaustive certification or mathematical peer review.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for Haar-central sections of the unit-vertex regular octahedron in dimension three. No higher-dimensional, noncentral, or non-Haar conclusion. Historical priority of a specialized stereological formula is not conclusively settled.
title: Exact inradius law and a second-derivative transition for random octahedron sections
